The Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) methodology is an operational tool designed for Ministries of Health in NTD-endemic countries to determine if the threshold for launching disease-specific public health interventions has been reached.
The ITM methodology balances epidemiologic rigor with field practicality to provide a simpler and quicker way for Ministries of Health to estimate their neglected tropical disease (NTD) needs.

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: ClfB is crucial for determining abscess structure and bacterial burden early in skin infection through a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin expressed in abscess tissue.
evidence_rows.core_keep_af: ClfB is crucial in determining the abscess structure and bacterial burden early in infection and this is dependent upon a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin which is expressed within the abscess tissue.
evidence_rows.expert_summary_hint: ClfB helps bacteria form skin abscesses by binding to loricrin in the infected tissue.
evidence_rows.lay_context: ClfB binds to loricrin, a protein found in the skin abscess wall, which influences how the abscess forms and how many bacteria grow early in infection.
allowed_evidence_spans: ClfB is crucial in determining the abscess structure and bacterial burden early in infection and this is dependent upon a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin which is expressed within the abscess tissue .

At 48 h post-infection loricrin is clearly visible in the epidermal layer of the skin, which is to be expected as it is a major component of the cornified envelope. Interestingly, it is also detected in the abscess wall structure following challenge with both LAC::lux and LAC::lux ΔclfB.

Mice infected with LAC::lux ΔclfB formed significantly smaller abscess lesions on day 3–6 compared to mice infected with LAC::lux ( Fig 1A and 1B ) . The bioluminescence signal was also reduced in LAC::lux ΔclfB infected animals compared to LAC::lux infected mice ( Fig 1C and 1D ) . The reduction in bioluminescence signal was validated by quantifying the bacterial burden in the skin on day 3 ( Fig 1E ) and day 6 ( Fig 1F ) .

Taken together, these results demonstrate that ClfB affects both the rate of abscess formation and the overall size of the abscess formed, which ultimately leads to greater bacterial burden in the skin.
forbidden_overgeneralizations: ClfB affects all infection stages equally

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: Vaccination targeting ClfB induces protective humoral and cellular immune responses and leads to protection during Staphylococcus aureus skin infection.
evidence_rows.core_keep_af: Targeting ClfB using a model vaccine that induced both protective humoral and cellular responses , leads to protection during S . aureus skin infection .
evidence_rows.expert_summary_hint: A vaccine against ClfB protects mice from skin infection by activating immune defenses.
evidence_rows.lay_context: Vaccinating mice with ClfB triggered immune responses involving antibodies and immune cells, which reduced abscess size and bacterial levels during infection.
allowed_evidence_spans: Targeting ClfB using a model vaccine that induced both protective humoral and cellular responses , leads to protection during S . aureus skin infection .

Immunization with ClfB in combination with CpG drove a significant increase in ClfB-specific IFNγ, IL-17 and IL-22 producing CD4+ T cells by inguinal lymph node cells compared to CpG-immunized mice. ClfB-specific CD8+ T cells producing IFNγ, IL-17 and IL-22 were also increased. Vaccination with ClfB also induced significantly elevated ClfB-specific serum IgG titres in mice compared to the control group.

Mice vaccinated with ClfB in combination with CpG developed significantly smaller abscess lesions throughout the 6-day infection period compared to those vaccinated with adjuvant alone ... and the bacterial burden in the skin of ClfB vaccinated mice was decreased throughout the course of infection as measured by bioluminescence .

Vaccination with ClfB+CpG also activated humoral immune responses by inducing significant levels of ClfB-specific neutralizing antibodies compared to controls . This demonstrates that ClfB can activate both the humoral and cellular arms of the immune system which combined led to a substantial reduction in the severity of the subsequent LAC::lux skin infection , with reduced bacterial burden throughout the course of infection and a significant reduction in the abscess lesion area when compared to the adjuvant alone control group .

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: A novel degradation pathway targets the F-box protein Met30 when it is dissociated from Skp1, involving the ubiquitin-proteasome system.

allowed_evidence_spans: We were interested in how cells cope with the generated excess of Met30 because the well-described autocatalytic F-box protein degradation pathway [10 , 11] cannot act on Met30 during these conditions . Interestingly , degradation of the F-box protein Met30 was maintained and even slightly induced in response to cadmium stress ( Fig 1A ) .

A mutant form of Met30 lacking its entire F-box domain ( Met30ΔFbox ) was constitutively unstable even though cells did not experience cadmium stress ( Fig 1B ) . Rapid degradation of Met30ΔFbox was observed both in cycloheximide chase and promoter shut-off experiments , indicating that components of this degradation pathway are constitutively present and that new protein synthesis is not required ( S1A
Inhibition of proteasome activity with MG-132 led to stabilization of Met30ΔFbox , suggesting that the ubiquitin proteasome pathway is involved in degradation of ‘Skp1-free’ Met30 ( Fig 2A ) .

These results suggest a proteolytic pathway that recognizes unbound ‘Skp1-free’ Met30 to avoid accumulation of excess unbound Met30 , which could bind substrates and shield them from recognition by fully assembled SCFMet30 complexes .

This ubiquitylation and degradation pathway acts on Met30 that is dissociated from Skp1 . Unexpectedly , this pathway required the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1 but was independent of the other central SCF component Skp1 .
Unexpectedly , Cdc53 was indispensable for Met30ΔFbox degradation , because inactivation of the temperature sensitive cdc53-1 allele blocked degradation ( Fig 2B ) .
Consistent with results using temperature sensitive alleles of skp1 , Met30ΔFbox degradation was unaffected when Skp1 function was blocked using the skp1-td strategy ( Fig 3C ) .
The experiments with skp1 single and skp1 cdc53 double mutants strongly suggested that the ‘Skp1-free’ degradation pathway for Met30 was dependent on Cdc53 and independent of Skp1

We reasoned that the Skp1-independent degradation pathway should be particularly important for the recovery from heavy metal stress . Cadmium exposure leads to dissociation of Met30 from Skp1 [24 , 26 , 27] thereby generating a burst of ‘Skp1-free’ Met30 , which needs to be controlled by the ‘Skp1-free’ F-box protein degradation pathway .
In addition to enhanced cadmium sensitivity, Met30M178E/I179E mutants displayed increased chromosome loss.
